name: GAIN side-scaled balanceOf lets the pair be skimmed for amplified surplus
summary: GAIN's balanceOf scales accounts assigned to a 'side' by TOTAL_GONS/_sideA, while _transferFrom moves gons at _gonsPerFragment (TOTAL_GONS/_totalSupply); the WETH pair had been auto-assigned SideA and _sideA had grown about 8.6e11 times past the capped _totalSupply, so any GAIN sent to the pair raised its reported balance 8.6e11-fold. The attacker sent dust GAIN to the pair and skimmed the inflated surplus twice, collapsing the pair's GAIN reserve, then sold 1.3 billion GAIN for the pair's WETH.
notes: Reset: setMaxWalletSize (0xa0e76f39, 2022-07-28), which first lifted the launch wallet cap of 10,000 GAIN (1e9 units, slot 0xf) that the anchor's skims of 7.2e13 and 1.4e14 units to the attacker could not pass; the launch max-transaction cap was lifted two blocks earlier (0xe9947c80) and stayed above the anchor's transfers from then on, and the setTrading calls around it only switched trading that had run since 2022-07-21 (rule 8). The pair got SideA automatically when liquidity was first added; the snaps and setRewardYield (0x43c42c12, 2022-07-28) only set how far _sideA diverged, i.e. the amplification and loss size; setAutoAddLiquidity(false) does not touch the exploited path.

setPairAddress(WETH) (0xc2480983, 2022-10-30) put every transfer into the real pair under the max-wallet check, which the pair's inflated balance (1.8e26 units) exceeded once 0x41640d22 had cut the cap to 3.25e19 units the same day, so sells were impossible until setMaxWalletSize raised the cap on 2023-10-25 (first sufficient raise 0x5283f729; latest 0x5dcf1b52). The path had been usable before: from 2022-07-29 to 2022-10-30 the real pair was pairAddress and exempt from the wallet check, both caps stood at 1e66 units, the buy-code check was off and _sideA was already 8.6e11 times _totalSupply. The 2023 raise re-opened that path, which is pause state, not a first activation (rule 8); counting it would cut the age to about four months.

Campaign: every Sync of the WETH/GAIN pair in which the GAIN reserve fell more than 1% without a WETH inflow, from deployment to block 26.1M; only the anchor and a 2026 copycat match (a 2022 hit is a proportional LP burn). GAIN is unpriced and was sold back into the same pair, so only WETH counts (rule 12).
